learning_outcomes.text: Students have an overview of project management and leadership methodologies.
Students who have successfully completed this module have a deeper understanding of: the systematics of project management methods with special consideration of the current state of the art.
Students who have successfully completed this module have a deeper understanding of: evaluating decision-making processes in a company context.
Students who have successfully completed this module have a deeper understanding of: mastering team development processes and conflict management.
Students who have successfully completed this module have a deeper understanding of: knowing the basic principles of leadership theories.
Students who have successfully completed this module have a deeper understanding of: using tools and methods.

Students reflect on project management concepts in a situational context, especially concerning team leadership. These are viewed in relation to the complex context in the respective organization and project phase and critically weighed against each other. Problems are solved with professional plausibility against the background of possible connections.
Students can systematically apply project management tools. They understand project management as team leadership and can specifically use different leadership styles in group dynamic processes.

Students master the systematics of project management and leadership theories. They can independently work through further literature. Students can independently classify new research results and verify hypotheses using suitable specialist scientific methods.
Students can present the tasks of project management using technical vocabulary and specifically apply various communication techniques.
Students can classify further specialist literature on project management according to the current state of research.

syllabus_topics: Project management (project definition, project planning, project control, project closure, time management)
Organizational theory (terms, concepts, management organization, process organization)
Leadership theory (definitions and roots, leadership theoretical concepts, trait approaches, behavioral approaches, situational approaches, newer leadership approaches)
Leadership practice - overview (terms, leadership competence, leadership styles, leadership levels)
Self-leadership (personal values and abilities, personality and development models)
Employee leadership (goal setting, situational leadership, performance evaluation, communication theory)
Team leadership (team development, leadership methods, conflict management, team meetings)
Corporate management (work organization, values and visions, leadership strategies, change management)
assessment_rules: The graded examination performance can be a term paper (approx. 20 pages, possibly 20 min explanation), a presentation (approx. 20 min, with approx. 20 pages elaboration), or a written project report (approx. 20 pages, possibly 20 min explanation). The form of examination may take into account the number of participants.
